issues: The leader heal/draw effects are encoded for the caster instead of the selected follower's controller. It should banish the chosen anyFollower, then give that follower's leader defense +2 and have that follower's controller draw 1; this requires controller-relative target/effect support based on the selected target's controller, which is not implemented in the ability reference.
Remove the incorrect keyword 'fanfare'; this card has no Fanfare keyword.

The activation condition is encoded incorrectly as namedFollowerOnFieldByName: 'Marine'. It should require that there is a Marine follower on your field, which should be encoded with a field-trait follower condition; add engine support for a condition like fieldTraitMin with trait 'Marine' scoped to followers if needed.

The first spell effect should deal 1 damage to each follower on the field, not just enemies. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with an all-followers effect such as dealDamageOtherFollowers plus self damage support, or implement a dedicated operation for 'deal damage to each follower on the field.'

The Overflow clause is encoded with the wrong target. It should give Storm to each 'Galmieux, Ardent Disdain' on your field, not an arbitrary selfFollower; encode it as a field-wide named target grant, and implement support for targeting/granting keywords to all allied followers matching a specific identity name.

The Fanfare is incomplete/incorrect. It should search for up to 2 Earth Sigil amulets with total cost 4 or less, put them into your EX area, shuffle, and make those cards cost 0 to play this turn. The current tutorFromDeck fetches only one card, uses identityName 'Earth Sigil' instead of the Earth Sigil amulet classification, and omits the temporary cost reduction; implement support for tutoring multiple cards with a max total cost to EX area and applying a temporary play cost reduction to the tutored cards.

The end-phase damage effect is encoded incorrectly as dealDamageAllEnemies. The source says 'deal 2 damage to each enemy leader'; in multiplayer this means each opponent leader only, not followers. It should be a leader-only multi-opponent damage effect, which is not implemented and should be added.

The end-phase buff target is too broad as any selfFollower without reflecting 'Select a follower on your field' across all your followers if non-follower cards can also be on field; use the appropriate allied follower selector if available.
